data.narrative: Mastered complex multi-layer system debugging across asynchronous and caching boundaries. Systematically disproved superficial hypotheses to uncover missing cache invalidation (Bug #9), mapped the full 12-step cascading failure chain of queue retry storms to implement a 3-part fix with exponential backoff and bulkhead connection pool isolation (Bug #10), and successfully diagnosed and decoupled overloaded cache namespaces in the secondary break.
